name: Early Morning Snow
source:
This story is about two old friends meeting back up in their hometown.  Will they reconnect with each other or will the past drive them apart again? 

[From [url=https://bediverebadger.itch.io/early-morning-snow]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这个故事讲的是两个老朋友回到家乡重逢。他们能重新亲近起来，还是过去又会把他们分开？
